entities.summary: The Margraviate of the Nordgau or Bavarian Nordgau was a medieval administrative unit (Gau) on the northern frontiers of the Duchy of Bavaria. It comprised the region north of the Danube and Regensburg, roughly covered by the modern Upper Palatinate, and stretching towards the Upper Franconia. Its eastern borders towards the Duchy of Bohemia were guarded by marches centred in Cham and Nabburg.
